Begin helper follows selected borrow; end helper follows loan.end and samples the local owner before the next Core instruction. Selected function allocations retain zero initialization so newly observed endpoint reads do not expose formerly unread allocation contents.
Runtime branches on zero extent before either endpoint dereference; parser requires both recorded endpoint bytes to be zero for empty view.

ACK write and ack_sent transition occur under the same Condition in observer thread; the same thread parses end records. Resume requests require a prior begin and cannot enqueue twice.

Generation/image captured and reference incremented under dispatcher lock before execution thread starts. Rollback affects future admission; inactive candidate descriptor waits for zero tracked references.
Ordinary execute rejects diagnostic images; start_loan_probe rejects ordinary images. Diagnostic compiler has separate schema/profile and false production/timing/refinement claims.
Cancel withdraws publication; real compiler is not preempted. Finished unpublished image closes; current generation is unchanged. Only one background build and two version identities admitted.

Finite timeout/parse/child failure releases the tracked dispatch reference; partial selected-loan records remain in handle. No trap cause or language destructor is inferred from SIGABRT/OS termination.
Close rejects new work, keeps admitted references until observer completes, and reports drain of tracked host inventory. Reap-failure qualification gap is separately listed.

Passing fixed producer requires seven completed control outcomes (four return/two trap/one timeout), not just an attempt count. CLI labels attempt length as actual_child_calls even on failure; separately listed.

Producer copies actual sealed image bytes, checks hash/length and retains canonical Core, diagnostic IR, receipts and transition/loan snapshots. Exclusive new directory and checkpointing prevent normal accidental overwrite.

Producer requires clean Git status and unchanged bounded source snapshots for ok. This establishes tracked-source cleanliness; ignored non-code snapshot inputs are not thereby attested as committed, and host/compiler TCB remains explicit.
Compilation/interruption/snapshot errors leave checkpoint; active calls retain finite deadlines while close waits. execution_passed is kept distinct from committed-source ok.

issues.finding: If proc.wait(timeout=2) itself raises, _run still calls _release. The dispatcher can subsequently report drained while the OS child has not been confirmed reaped. SIGKILL pending on an uninterruptible kernel wait does not establish immediate disappearance of the process or its kernel resources.
issues.impact: Do not equate tracked-host drain with unconditional OS-process/resource drain; no safe reuse of child-owned external state is qualified. The sealed mapping still has the child OS reference, so this is not evidence of use-after-free.
issues.location: hepta/hia_native_loan_probe.py: NativeLoanExecution._observe / _run; ordinary observer shares the bounded-reap assumption
issues.recommended_next_step: For production lifecycle scope, retain explicit unresolved-child ownership until confirmed reap or expose incomplete-cleanup state; add a meaningful controlled reap-failure test. No frozen source edit performed.
issues.status: static review; not triggered in retained finite executions

issues.finding: begin appends its attempt before dispatcher/thread/Popen success. CLI actual_child_calls uses len(attempts), so a spawn failure may overstate actual child executions in a failed run.
issues.impact: Interpret len(attempts) as attempted calls unless individual native observations establish actual execution. A passed fixed run has the expected outcome evidence for all seven.
issues.recommended_next_step: Rename the CLI field to attempted_child_calls or separately record spawn and completion identities. Preserve the current failed-run raw report; do not relabel an attempt as execution.
issues.status: static review; passing seven-call report unaffected
